dialogues.jp:
「……と、さくらが講師になるのを反対してい
　た人間が事故にあったという話があるわけだ」
dialogues.en:
"I heard that the people who were trying to kick Sakura out
of her teaching position got into accidents."
dialogues.text:
"I heard that the people who were trying to kick Sakura out
of her teaching position got into accidents."

dialogues.jp:
がく、がく、と音夢が船をこいでいる……食事
中にご飯に箸をつっこんだままというのは珍し
い。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's dozing off in the middle of eating. I've never seen
anybody sleeping while leaving their chopsticks in the rice
before.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's dozing off in the middle of eating. I've never seen
anybody sleeping while leaving their chopsticks in the rice
before.

dialogues.jp: 「おぃ、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ふわっ、んん……ん？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Huh...mmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Huh...mmm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「起きろよ」
dialogues.en: "Wake up."
dialogues.text: "Wake up."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ……また寝てた？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, was I sleeping again?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, was I sleeping again?"

dialogues.jp: 箸から手を離して、目をこする。
dialogues.en: She wiped her eyes after putting down the chopsticks.
dialogues.text: She wiped her eyes after putting down the chopsticks.

dialogues.jp: 「またって？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by again?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by again?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん……昨日から今日の夜まで寝っぱなしだっ
　たのに」
dialogues.en: "Mm... I slept from yesterday through this morning."
dialogues.text: "Mm... I slept from yesterday through this morning."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　丸１日か？」
dialogues.en: "What? For 24 hours?"
dialogues.text: "What? For 24 hours?"

dialogues.jp:
朝はさくらに起こされたので、まさか音夢が寝
たままだとは思わなかった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura woke me up this morning, so I didn't know Nemu was
still sleeping then.
dialogues.text:
Sakura woke me up this morning, so I didn't know Nemu was
still sleeping then.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.jp: がく、と音夢の顔が弁当に突っ込む。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Nemu's face crashed into the food.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Nemu's face crashed into the food.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ！？」
dialogues.en: "Wha!?"
dialogues.text: "Wha!?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにやってるんだお前！？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふぇ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Aaahh!"
dialogues.text: "Aaahh!"

dialogues.jp:
慌ててタオルを持ってきて、半泣きの音夢の顔
を拭いてやる。
dialogues.en: I take a towel and clean her half-crying face.
dialogues.text: I take a towel and clean her half-crying face.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……子供かまったく」
dialogues.en: "Huh... You're such a baby."
dialogues.text: "Huh... You're such a baby."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんが、さくらの話ばっかりするから
　だよぉ」
dialogues.en: "It's because you talked about Sakura too much, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "It's because you talked about Sakura too much, oniichan."

dialogues.jp: お兄ちゃん、って寝ぼけているな……。
dialogues.en: 'Oniichan'... She must be half asleep.
dialogues.text: 'Oniichan'... She must be half asleep.

dialogues.jp: 「関係ないだろうが」
dialogues.en: "She's nothing to do with this."
dialogues.text: "She's nothing to do with this."

dialogues.jp: ピンと軽くデコピンする。
dialogues.en: I flick her forehead with my finger.
dialogues.text: I flick her forehead with my finger.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うあ！　あるよ〜、さくらの話をされると、
　本当に眠くなるんだもん」
dialogues.en:
"Ow! Yes, it is. When you talk about Sakura, I get so
sleepy."
dialogues.text:
"Ow! Yes, it is. When you talk about Sakura, I get so
sleepy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ？」
dialogues.en: "What does that mean?"
dialogues.text: "What does that mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「本当だよ……こんなに眠るようになったのだっ
　て、お兄ちゃんがさくらの話を毎日しだして
　からだもん」
dialogues.en:
"It's true. I sleep a lot these days since you've been
talking about her every day."
dialogues.text:
"It's true. I sleep a lot these days since you've been
talking about her every day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「毎日？」
dialogues.en: "Every day?"
dialogues.text: "Every day?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
えーと、意識はしていないが、確かに最近の俺
が関わっているのはさくらの件だけか。
dialogues.en:
Well, I'm not doing it consciously, but it may be true,
because I've been involved in only Sakura's case recently.
dialogues.text:
Well, I'm not doing it consciously, but it may be true,
because I've been involved in only Sakura's case recently.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さくらだけは……許せないと思ってたんだけ
　どなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I thought I couldn't forgive her no matter what."
dialogues.text: "I thought I couldn't forgive her no matter what."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が俺の隣に移って、こつん、と頭を肩にの
せる。
dialogues.en: Nemu sits next to me, and puts her head on my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Nemu sits next to me, and puts her head on my shoulder.

dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、なんでそんなに、さくらを目の
　敵にしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "I want to know why you always treat her like an enemy."
dialogues.text: "I want to know why you always treat her like an enemy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "Well, because..."
dialogues.text: "Well, because..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「この際はっきりさせておこう。いつまでも、
　そんな仲が悪い状態だと俺が面倒だ」
dialogues.en:
"I want you to make it clear once and for all. If you keep
up with this, I'll be in trouble."
dialogues.text:
"I want you to make it clear once and for all. If you keep
up with this, I'll be in trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あくまで自分のためなんですね」
dialogues.en: "You're doing this just for your own sake, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "You're doing this just for your own sake, aren't you?"

dialogues.jp: ぼそぼそ、と呟きながら音夢がため息をつく。
dialogues.en: Nemu mumbles with a sigh.
dialogues.text: Nemu mumbles with a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あの、その……昔、さくらが引っ越した日の
　ことを覚えてる？」
dialogues.en: "Well, um... Do you remember when Sakura moved out?"
dialogues.text: "Well, um... Do you remember when Sakura moved out?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お前が家出した日な」
dialogues.en: "The day you ran away from home, right?"
dialogues.text: "The day you ran away from home, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「さくらが引っ越した日です！」
dialogues.en: "No, the day Sakura moved out!"
dialogues.text: "No, the day Sakura moved out!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どっちでもいいけどな……」
dialogues.en: "Whatever it is..."
dialogues.text: "Whatever it is..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の妹になって迷惑をかけていると勘違いした
音夢が家出をして、それを探しているときに、
さくらから別れを告げられた日だ。
dialogues.en:
That was the day when Nemu ran away from home thinking she
was causing trouble by being my sister. While I was looking
for her, I met Sakura, and she told me she was leaving.
dialogues.text:
That was the day when Nemu ran away from home thinking she
was causing trouble by being my sister. While I was looking
for her, I met Sakura, and she told me she was leaving.

dialogues.jp:
さくらと最後に出会った桜の木の裏に、音夢が
いたという、冗談みたいなオチがついている思
い出。
dialogues.en:
Then, Nemu was hiding behind the cherry tree where I saw
Sakura for the last time. What a twisted ending!
dialogues.text:
Then, Nemu was hiding behind the cherry tree where I saw
Sakura for the last time. What a twisted ending!

dialogues.jp: 「あれがどうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What's that got to do with it?"
dialogues.text: "What's that got to do with it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……あの時、さくらは私がいることに気づい
　ていたんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Sakura knew I was there."
dialogues.text: "Sakura knew I was there."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、子供時代のことで自分でも大人げない
　んですけど、私がいることを知っててあんな
　約束をしたんです」
dialogues.en:
"Well, as you know I was still a child and immature, but I'm
sure she deliberately made a promise with you while knowing
I was behind the tree."
dialogues.text:
"Well, as you know I was still a child and immature, but I'm
sure she deliberately made a promise with you while knowing
I was behind the tree."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「約束って、また会おうねってやつだよな？」
dialogues.en:
"When you say promise, you mean the one to meet again,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"When you say promise, you mean the one to meet again,
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えぇ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
頭痛でもするのか、こめかみを押さえて音夢が
頷く。
dialogues.en: Nemu nods, rubbing her temples as if she had a headache.
dialogues.text: Nemu nods, rubbing her temples as if she had a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あと、それと合わせて、再会したら恋人にな
　ろうねって」
dialogues.en:
"And plus, she said she wanted to be your lover when she saw
you again."
dialogues.text:
"And plus, she said she wanted to be your lover when she saw
you again."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ずっと忘れてたのに、さくらが昔のままの姿
　で現れたのを見て思い出してしまって……」
dialogues.en:
"I remember now when I saw Sakura, when she showed up
looking just like she did in the old days."
dialogues.text:
"I remember now when I saw Sakura, when she showed up
looking just like she did in the old days."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ストップストップ。なに？　恋人になろう
　ね？」
dialogues.en: "Hold on a second. What? Be my lover next time?"
dialogues.text: "Hold on a second. What? Be my lover next time?"

dialogues.jp: まったく身に覚えのない約束に眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en: I knit my brows at the promise I don't remember.
dialogues.text: I knit my brows at the promise I don't remember.

dialogues.jp:
「どこぞの温泉旅館を舞台にした、ベタな恋愛
　漫画の話か？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you talking about some shitty love story in a Japanese
inn with a hot spring?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you talking about some shitty love story in a Japanese
inn with a hot spring?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まさか……さくらとお前で約束したのか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you make that kind of promise with Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Did you make that kind of promise with Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「バカばっか言ってないでよ……お兄ちゃんと
　に決まってるでしょうが」
dialogues.en: "Don't be silly. Of course, it was with you."
dialogues.text: "Don't be silly. Of course, it was with you."

dialogues.jp: 肩を落としてため息。
dialogues.en: I breathe a sigh while sagging my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I breathe a sigh while sagging my shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あの桜の木の下で交わした約束は、成就する
　という｛いわ／曰｝くまであったんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"The promise she made under the cherry tree had a certain
reason to fall through."
dialogues.text:
"The promise she made under the cherry tree had a certain
reason to fall through."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それに、滝くんとショウくんを階段から突き
　落としたのだって、さくらの仕業だって――」
dialogues.en:
"And they say Sakura pushed Taki-kun and Shu-kun down the
stairs."
dialogues.text:
"And they say Sakura pushed Taki-kun and Shu-kun down the
stairs."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て！？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second!"
dialogues.text: "Wait a second!"

dialogues.jp: 頭が混乱していた。
dialogues.en: I'm confused.
dialogues.text: I'm confused.

dialogues.jp:
「さくらが突き落としたぁ！？　その前に、滝
　とショウって誰だ？」
dialogues.en: "Did Sakura push them? Who are Taki and Shu, anyway?"
dialogues.text: "Did Sakura push them? Who are Taki and Shu, anyway?"

dialogues.jp:
話に置いてきぼり過ぎて、思わずおかしな声を
上げてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I speak in a strange voice, realizing I'm not following her
story at all.
dialogues.text:
I speak in a strange voice, realizing I'm not following her
story at all.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「昔のクラスメイトでしょうが。さくらをイジ
　メてたってお兄ちゃんが言ってたよ」
dialogues.en:
"They were your old classmates, weren't they? You told me
before that they used to pick on Sakura."
dialogues.text:
"They were your old classmates, weren't they? You told me
before that they used to pick on Sakura."

dialogues.jp: 当たり前のように音夢が呟く。
dialogues.en: Nemu murmurs in front of me.
dialogues.text: Nemu murmurs in front of me.

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「五月先生も可哀想だったよね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, poor Satsuki-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Oh, poor Satsuki-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……音夢、前世の記憶でも甦っちまったか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you regressed to a previous life?"
dialogues.text: "Have you regressed to a previous life?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……忘れちゃったの？」
dialogues.en: "Have you forgotten?"
dialogues.text: "Have you forgotten?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待ってて」
dialogues.en: "Hold on."
dialogues.text: "Hold on."

dialogues.jp:
こんこん、と咳をしながら音夢が居間を出て行っ
て、どこからか昔の卒業アルバムを持ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu leaves the living room, then comes back with an old
student yearbook from somewhere.
dialogues.text:
Nemu leaves the living room, then comes back with an old
student yearbook from somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えーと……ほら、これがお兄ちゃんね」
dialogues.en: "Let's see... This is you, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Let's see... This is you, oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
遠足のものらしいどこかの遊園地での集合写真。
その中の生意気そうなガキを音夢が指差す。
dialogues.en:
It looks like a field trip, and a group picture at an
amusement park somewhere. Nemu points at a sassy-looking
kid.
dialogues.text:
It looks like a field trip, and a group picture at an
amusement park somewhere. Nemu points at a sassy-looking
kid.

dialogues.jp:
ざっと目で追って、すぐに目立つ髪をしている、
さくらも見つけた……というか俺の隣。
dialogues.en:
Looking through the picture, I find Sakura easily, because
her hair stands out among them, and she was right next to
me.
dialogues.text:
Looking through the picture, I find Sakura easily, because
her hair stands out among them, and she was right next to
me.

dialogues.jp: 「滝とシュウって……」
dialogues.en: "Where are Taki and Shu?"
dialogues.text: "Where are Taki and Shu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、これ、分かりやすい」
dialogues.en: "See, here they are."
dialogues.text: "See, here they are."

dialogues.jp:
音夢が指差したふたりは、皆の列から少し離れ
たところにいた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu pointed them out. They were a little away from
everybody else.
dialogues.text:
Nemu pointed them out. They were a little away from
everybody else.

dialogues.jp: ふたりとも、足にギブスをはめている。
dialogues.en: Both of them had a plaster cast on their legs.
dialogues.text: Both of them had a plaster cast on their legs.

dialogues.jp:
怖々とひとりがさくらのほうに目線を送ってい
た。
dialogues.en: One of them was looking at Sakura fearfully.
dialogues.text: One of them was looking at Sakura fearfully.

dialogues.jp: 覚えていない？
dialogues.en: Don't you remember them?
dialogues.text: Don't you remember them?

dialogues.jp:
昔のクラスメイトを全員覚えているなんて、さ
すがに俺だって思っていない。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't expect to remember every classmate I had in the
past.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't expect to remember every classmate I had in the
past.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、これは、そういうことじゃなくて……普
通は肌とか感覚が覚えてはいるのだ。
dialogues.en:
But this time, it was not about that. Usually, your body or
the feelings inside you are supposed to keep those memories.
dialogues.text:
But this time, it was not about that. Usually, your body or
the feelings inside you are supposed to keep those memories.

dialogues.jp: なのに、そんな単純な感覚ではないのだ。
dialogues.en: But it's not that simple of a feeling for me.
dialogues.text: But it's not that simple of a feeling for me.

dialogues.jp:
他のみんなは覚えているのに、まるで場違いな
心霊写真のようにそのふたりだけが浮いている。
dialogues.en:
I remember everyone, but they are vague figures, almost like
you see in ghost photography.
dialogues.text:
I remember everyone, but they are vague figures, almost like
you see in ghost photography.

dialogues.jp: なんだ、これ？
dialogues.en: What's going on?
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.jp: 「……詳しく話してくれ」
dialogues.en: "Can you explain the details?"
dialogues.text: "Can you explain the details?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにを？」
dialogues.en: "What about?"
dialogues.text: "What about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その階段から突き落とされた事件って」
dialogues.en:
"Tell me more about the incident when they were pushed down
the stairs."
dialogues.text:
"Tell me more about the incident when they were pushed down
the stairs."

dialogues.jp: 俺は真剣に頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: I drop my head down.
dialogues.text: I drop my head down.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は不思議そうに首をかしげるが、分かった、
とアルバムを閉じてソファーに座りなおす。
dialogues.en:
Nemu tilts her head quizzically, then sits down on the couch
while closing the album.
dialogues.text:
Nemu tilts her head quizzically, then sits down on the couch
while closing the album.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、単純だよ。遠足に行くときにさくら
　とそのふたりが同じ班になって、男の子達が
　ひどいこと言ってさくらを嫌がったの」
dialogues.en:
"Hm... it's simple. When they were about to go on a field
trip, Sakura was in the same group as them, but the boys
said an awful thing to her."
dialogues.text:
"Hm... it's simple. When they were about to go on a field
trip, Sakura was in the same group as them, but the boys
said an awful thing to her."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それでかばったお兄ちゃんにも悪口を言って。
　遠足が近づいてきたある日、階段から落ちて
　足の骨を折ったの」
dialogues.en:
"Then, they said bad things about you when you covered up
for Sakura. And just before the field trip, they broke their
legs by falling down the stairs."
dialogues.text:
"Then, they said bad things about you when you covered up
for Sakura. And just before the field trip, they broke their
legs by falling down the stairs."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「その時、階段の上にさくらがいたって……ん？
　どっかで聞いたことが」
dialogues.en:
"When that happened, they saw Sakura at the top on the
stairs... Well, that sounds familiar."
dialogues.text:
"When that happened, they saw Sakura at the top on the
stairs... Well, that sounds familiar."

dialogues.jp:
音夢は、桜の枝で頭を打った少女の話をしてい
るのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I know Nemu's talking about the girl who got a cherry branch
on her head.
dialogues.text:
I know Nemu's talking about the girl who got a cherry branch
on her head.

dialogues.jp: さくらをイジメて足を折ったふたりの少年。
dialogues.en: Two boys broke their legs after they picked on Sakura.
dialogues.text: Two boys broke their legs after they picked on Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの悪口を言い、その後に不慮の事故にあっ
た少女。
dialogues.en:
The girl who talked bad about Sakura got in an accident
afterward.
dialogues.text:
The girl who talked bad about Sakura got in an accident
afterward.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの講師としての権限を取り上げようとし
て、交通事故にあった学園の経営陣。
dialogues.en:
The administration that tried to eliminate her from a
teaching position got into accidents.
dialogues.text:
The administration that tried to eliminate her from a
teaching position got into accidents.

dialogues.jp: 俺はアルバムを引き寄せる。
dialogues.en: I bring the album closer.
dialogues.text: I bring the album closer.

dialogues.jp: 「先生は？」
dialogues.en: "What happened with the teacher?"
dialogues.text: "What happened with the teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんとか先生も可哀想だね……って」
dialogues.en: "Poor so-and-so."
dialogues.text: "Poor so-and-so."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「五月先生のこと？」
dialogues.en: "Are you talking about Satsuki-sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Are you talking about Satsuki-sensei?"

dialogues.jp:
さも俺が知っていると言うように、音夢が首を
かしげる。
dialogues.en: Nemu tilts her head, wondering how I knew about her.
dialogues.text: Nemu tilts her head, wondering how I knew about her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あの……さくらのイジメを謝罪に行った帰り
　に交通事故で……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, after she apologized about Sakura's bullying, she got
in an accident on the way back, and..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, after she apologized about Sakura's bullying, she got
in an accident on the way back, and..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Did she die?"
dialogues.text: "Did she die?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さくらが引越したのも、そのせいだって話も
　出たくらいだからね」
dialogues.en: "They say that's why Sakura moved away."
dialogues.text: "They say that's why Sakura moved away."

dialogues.jp: 吐き気がした。
dialogues.en: I feel sick.
dialogues.text: I feel sick.

dialogues.jp:
俺の記憶が、まるで俺のものでないように語ら
れている。
dialogues.en: It sounds like it has nothing to do with my memory.
dialogues.text: It sounds like it has nothing to do with my memory.

dialogues.jp:
自分の知らないことが、しかし、写真や音夢の
中で確実に経過した時間として認識されている。
dialogues.en:
Even though I don't remember those things, they definitely
happened, because they're in Nemu's mind and the pictures.
dialogues.text:
Even though I don't remember those things, they definitely
happened, because they're in Nemu's mind and the pictures.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……とりあえず、そのお兄ちゃんって止
　めてくれ。背中がかゆい」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... Can you stop calling me 'oniichan'?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah... Can you stop calling me 'oniichan'?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「え？　お兄ちゃんって呼ばなかったら、なん
　て呼ぶのよ」
dialogues.en: "What? What else can I call you then?"
dialogues.text: "What? What else can I call you then?"

dialogues.jp: 怖々と音夢の目を覗き込む。
dialogues.en: I look into her eyes with fear.
dialogues.text: I look into her eyes with fear.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇ、どうしたのお兄ちゃん？　なんかおか
　しいよ、熱でもあるの？」
dialogues.en:
"What's going on, oniichan? You don't look good. Do you have
a fever?"
dialogues.text:
"What's going on, oniichan? You don't look good. Do you have
a fever?"

dialogues.jp: 怖々と俺の目を覗き返された。
dialogues.en: She looked back at me in concern.
dialogues.text: She looked back at me in concern.

dialogues.jp: 「これは夢か？」
dialogues.en: "Am I dreaming?"
dialogues.text: "Am I dreaming?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに言って……けほけほ……っ！」
dialogues.en: "What are you... cough, cough...!"
dialogues.text: "What are you... cough, cough...!"

dialogues.jp:
俺の頬に手を伸ばして微笑もうとした音夢が、
げほっ、と鈍い音をたててひどく咳き込む。
dialogues.en:
When Nemu tried to reach to put her hand on my cheek, she
had a coughing spell.
dialogues.text:
When Nemu tried to reach to put her hand on my cheek, she
had a coughing spell.

dialogues.jp: 「おぃ、お前が大丈夫かよ？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「げほっ……けほけほっ！！」
dialogues.en: "Cough... akhh, akh!"
dialogues.text: "Cough... akhh, akh!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢！」
dialogues.en: "Nemu!"
dialogues.text: "Nemu!"

dialogues.jp:
いつもと違う咳き込みかたに慌てて身体を抱き
寄せる。
dialogues.en:
I hold her body quickly as she coughs. She's never suffered
that bad before.
dialogues.text:
I hold her body quickly as she coughs. She's never suffered
that bad before.

dialogues.jp: 不思議な香りが鼻をついた。
dialogues.en: I smell something strange.
dialogues.text: I smell something strange.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が口元に当てていた手をはなすと、手のひ
らが真っ赤に染まっていた。
dialogues.en:
When Nemu takes her hands away from her mouth, I see her
palms painted bright red.
dialogues.text:
When Nemu takes her hands away from her mouth, I see her
palms painted bright red.

dialogues.jp: ――桜の花びらがのっていた。
dialogues.en: ---- There are cherry petals on them.
dialogues.text: ---- There are cherry petals on them.

dialogues.jp:
はらはら、と真っ赤な桜が、音夢の唇やシャツ
の袖口から舞い落ちる。
dialogues.en:
The bright red cherry petals are falling down from her lips
and sleeves of her shirt.
dialogues.text:
The bright red cherry petals are falling down from her lips
and sleeves of her shirt.

dialogues.jp: それはまるで、血のような赤。
dialogues.en: They're bright red like blood.
dialogues.text: They're bright red like blood.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「っく……おにい……ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Kuhh... Onii... chan...?"
dialogues.text: "Kuhh... Onii... chan...?"

dialogues.jp: この桜の枯れない島にあってなお――。
dialogues.en:
Even though we're on the island that keeps its cherry
blossom forever.
dialogues.text:
Even though we're on the island that keeps its cherry
blossom forever.

dialogues.jp: 常識外れた他人の夢を知っていてなお――。
dialogues.en: Even though I know other people's senseless dreams.
dialogues.text: Even though I know other people's senseless dreams.

dialogues.jp: その光景は異様な美しさだった。
dialogues.en: The view is incredibly beautiful.
dialogues.text: The view is incredibly beautiful.

dialogues.jp: 花に包まれたまま、音夢が意識を失った。
dialogues.en: Nemu falls unconscious, surrounded by the cherry petals.
dialogues.text: Nemu falls unconscious, surrounded by the cherry petals.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の発症◆
dialogues.en: ◆The start of symptoms in Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆The start of symptoms in Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらの講師を辞めさせる話がなくなった、と
音夢に今日の報告をする。
dialogues.en:
I told Nemu that they're not going to eliminate Sakura from
a teaching position any more.
dialogues.text:
I told Nemu that they're not going to eliminate Sakura from
a teaching position any more.

dialogues.jp:
そんな変な話が過去にもあったねと音夢に言わ
れるが、そこで語られた話は、俺が知っている
べきなのに、なぜか記憶から抜け落ちていた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu told me there was a similar story before, but I don't
have any memory of the event that even I should've
remembered.
dialogues.text:
Nemu told me there was a similar story before, but I don't
have any memory of the event that even I should've
remembered.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その関係者の中にさくらに関わって命
を落としてしまった｛・・／先生｝がいたことを知る。
dialogues.en:
And I found out that one of teachers who got involved with
Sakura passed away.
dialogues.text:
And I found out that one of teachers who got involved with
Sakura passed away.

dialogues.jp:
償い、という言葉を思い出していたら、突然、
目の前で花をこぼしながら、音夢が倒れてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
When I was thinking about the word 'redemption', Nemu
fainted before my eyes, spilling cherry petals everywhere.
dialogues.text:
When I was thinking about the word 'redemption', Nemu
fainted before my eyes, spilling cherry petals everywhere.
